about: Per-stock build recipe for tools/film_profiles/build.py. Source: Konica Minolta PROFESSIONAL 160 for Color Print brochure (AB3 0407T02M6, April 2004; professional_160.pdf, 125px.com mirror). Characteristic curves: daylight 1/125 s, Process CNK-4 (C-41 compatible), status M; sensitivity: status M, density 1.0 above D-min, relative log scale.

konica_professional_160.still_precedent: the shipped still portrait negatives (Kodak Portra 160, Fujifilm Pro 160S)
notes: Negs has no Konica QA RA-4 print paper; refined against kodak_portra_endura as the portrait RA-4 reference paper.

The 4-page 2004 brochure prints no RMS granularity; diffuse RMS granularity 4 (48 um aperture, D 1.0) is cross-verified from fresh-era datasheet compilations (cacreeks.com/films.htm and foto-35mm.narod.ru, matching Konica Centuria 100/200/400 = 4).
konica_professional_160.check6_fallback: the §D3 fallback (a flat extension past 700 nm) was not tried, as the worst point is not near 700 nm

y.relative_reason: Relative Speed (log) carries a 1.0 scale bar between the two horizontal gridlines and no tick values; the offset is arbitrary and D5 rescales every channel.
